    "title": "Girth-five conjecture for feasible partitions of multigraphs",
    "statement": "Let $G$ be a graph, and let $w_G(v)$ denote the number of edges parallel to an edge incident with $v$ beyond the first. The conjecture extends known feasible-partition results for triangle-free and girth-at-least-five graphs, but the paper notes that its proof attempt was incorrect; its resolution is not supplied here.",

    "statement": "Let $N\\geq 1$, let $\\mathbb{N}$ denote the nonnegative integers, and let $\\mathbf{1}=(1,\\ldots,1)\\in\\mathbb{N}^N$.
